name: Pepe's Assets Pack
description: The shared foundation every other Pepe's Pack builds on: shared textures, UI variables, and compatibility patches in one place. Must be enabled and sorted above every other Pepe's Pack to work.
author: Pepe

changelogs.1.1.1: Support for Speedometer. Fixed a bug where some zombie villagers wouldn't load properly.
changelogs.1.2.0: Support for Compass & Clock HUD. Fixed all the visual bugs. Added a variable to hide the Level Calculator.
changelogs.1.2.1: Bug Fixes: Fixed the hand bug (unknown). Fixed the bug of Clock and Compass not rendering (download Clock Compass HUD v1.0.1).
changelogs.1.3.0: Added support and variables for Death Coords & Better Hover Text.
changelogs.1.4.0: Added support for Waypoints+ pack. Fixed FPS Counter bug (unknown).
changelogs.1.5.0: Added Support for Shiny Pots and added Pots Item IDs.
changelogs.1.6.0: Added support for DebugHUD. Added Paperdoll fix.
changelogs.1.7.0: Added support for Better Armor Bar. Added Hand model fix for crossplay servers.

notice.title: A Must-Have for All Packs!
notice.intro: To ensure all your Pepe's Packs load and work perfectly, you must enable and place the Pepe's Pack Assets pack above all other packs in your load order.
notice.instruction: Download and Import it like a regular pack and make sure it's on top of the list.
notice.featuresTitle: What Does the Assets Pack Do?
notice.featuresIntro: This essential pack provides the core foundation for all other Pepe's Packs:

features.title: Seamless Compatibility
features.text: It makes every pack compatible with each other, ensuring they work together without issues.

features.title: Shared Resources
features.text: It contains crucial assets that multiple packs need, preventing duplication and keeping things tidy.

features.title: Full Customization
features.text: It allows you to easily configure settings across all your packs from one central place.

notice.critical: Your game will crash if the Pepe's Pack Assets isn't enabled! Don't forget to activate it!
